facts.fact: Swazi24 reports that an AI-powered diabetic retinopathy diagnostic system, from the Taiwan Technical Mission's NCD Project, was launched and is operational at six public hospitals and health centres (Mbabane Government, Piggs Peak, Mankayane, RFM, Dvokolwako, Emkhuzweni), officiated by the Minister of Health.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health with the Taiwan Technical Mission
systems.tiers: six public hospitals and health centres
